title: Claim no-confirmed-compromise says Hadrian and Patchstack 'report successful exploitation'; Security.NL and BleepingComputer's captures describe the same vendors' reports as attempts, not compromises. Grade the vendor half of the claim (found in the librarian's pass of 24 October)
note: Renumbered again on 24 October when the librarian's branch took in dev at v0.11.2. Renumbered a third time on 24 October (dev at v0.11.5). Run 3 (24 October): graded. As reworded the vendor half holds: Hadrian's "exploited at scale" (Insurance Business) and Patchstack's partner reports (Recorded Future) against its own telemetry's "only probing" (PCMag, Bitpage); BleepingComputer's "unsuccessful attempts" are before disclosure, a different window. Neither vendor's own post is captured, so that half is A3.
